title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta21

## Stable-preparation cleanup

This beta starts the final cleanup toward 0.5.0 stable and deliberately removes
maintainer-only development surfaces from the shipped integration before the
stable tag.

### Cleaner vendor notifications

The Navimow Device feed can return a real fault body/code with a broken localized
title such as `Completed on %@`. Navimower now normalizes unresolved vendor
placeholders before publishing the merged notification timeline.

- Confirmed vendor code `1003` is published as **Mowing motor undervoltage protection**.
- Other unresolved vendor titles fall back to a neutral
  **Mower notification (<code>)** label instead of exposing raw format tokens.
- Repeated vendor rows with the same code and normalized content are collapsed
  into one canonical notification when they fall within a five-minute event
  window anchored to the newest occurrence.
- The canonical row retains a backend `repeat_count`, while a recurrence outside
  that window becomes a new event.
- Grouping happens in the integration, so existing Map Card releases receive one
  clean row without a frontend update.

### Group-aware Mark as read

A collapsed row can represent several vendor `message_id` values. Navimower
keeps those IDs internally and one explicit **Mark as read** action opens every
retained member through the existing encrypted vendor detail route, then refreshes
the Device feed once.

The Map Card still sends only the representative visible `message_id`; it does
not need vendor-specific grouping logic.

### Remove prerelease raw/probe actions

The following maintainer-only research surfaces are removed from the public
integration package:

- `navimower.export_raw_data`;
- `navimower.probe_iot_file`;
- `raw_export.py`;
- `iot_file_probe.py`.

Home Assistant **Download diagnostics** remains the supported cached-only,
privacy-safe support export. Protocol research and raw field evidence are kept
outside the shipped integration.

### Action audit

The remaining Home Assistant actions were reviewed for stable use.

- Keep `continue_task` as the preferred continuation action.
- Keep low-level `resume` and `continue_last_ordered_run` for automation /
  backward compatibility rather than introduce a breaking removal immediately
  before 0.5.0 stable.
- Keep `relearn_georeference` as an advanced support action.
- Keep `refresh_map_snapshot` as a functional automation/image-refresh action
  and document it in the README.
- Schedule, notification-read and Map Card polygon-area actions remain unchanged.

### Still pending before stable

The legacy Off-limit-import **Custom Area** path is intentionally not removed in
this beta. Before 0.5.0 stable it will be consolidated with the Map Card-created
polygon Area system; dense imported vendor polygons will not be automatically
simplified or migrated.

No Map Card update is required for beta21.
